title: Oozy Chocolate Polish Cucumber Tart
description: A unique Polish dessert featuring cucumber and chocolate, perfect for a date night, this tart is low in glycemic index and rich in flavor. The combination of briny cucumber and oozy chocolate creates a delightful taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the almond flour and granulated sweetener.
Add the melted butter, eggs, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Press the mixture into the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch tart pan.
Arrange the sliced cucumbers on top of the tart crust.
Melt the dark chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Pour the melted chocolate over the cucumbers.
Refrigerate the tart for at least 2 hours to allow the chocolate to set.
